# `array_except`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
array_except(array1, array2)
```

Returns an array of the elements in array1 but not in array2,
without duplicates.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT array_except(array(1, 2, 3), array(1, 3, 5));
```

Result:

```text
[2]
```
